subject: POC kickoff recap: ACME pilot (scope, metrics, timeline)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.ai>, Tom Li <tom.li@acme.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff recap: ACME pilot (scope, metrics, timeline)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Wanted to capture the key points and next steps so we’re all aligned before the kickoff on Monday. High level summary below; I’ve attached a draft scope doc for your review (acme-poc-scope-v1.docx).

Summary of needs / pain points
- Primary goal: reduce customer support routing time by surfacing suggested responses and intent routing for Tier 1 tickets.
- Current system: rules-based triage + manual templates; average first-response time 22 hours, target < 4 hours for POC scope.
- Data constraints: PII redaction required; model cannot be persisted with PII.

Proposed POC scope (30 days)
- Inference surface: ticket summarization, intent classification, and suggested reply generation (top-3 suggestions).
- Evaluation metrics: suggestion precision@1, intent F1, latency p95 <= 300ms, weekly cost target <$1k.
- Prompt set / evals: we’ll use 200 representative tickets (seeded by Acme) for initial evals and hold out 50 for regression checks.

Owners & roles
- Acme: Sarah Patel (program owner), Tom Li (platform / infra).
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM / project lead), Aditya Rao (SE / implementation), Rishi Malhotra (CS / success metrics).

Timeline / milestones
- Day 0 (Mon 2026-08-31): kickoff + infra access and allowlist complete.
- Week 1: data mapping, prompt design, baseline evals.
- Week 2–3: model tuning, integration with staging ticket stream.
- Week 4: final eval, handoff, and next-steps review.

Access & setup steps (action items for Tom)
- Provide a staging AWS role or a pre-provisioned S3 bucket with sample tickets (CSV) + persona mapping.
- Add redwood-ips to allowlist using attached network-allowlist.csv.
- Grant Redwood service account read access to the ticket sample location or share pre-signed URLs.

Deliverables for kickoff
- Finalized scope doc (attached)
- Initial prompt list (we’ll share in a follow-up thread)
- Shared Drive folder link for ticket samples (I pasted a link below)

Next steps (short)
1) Sarah/Tom: confirm scope doc and share staging access + allowlist by EOD Monday.
2) Aditya: will send the initial prompt template and a minimal runbook for allowlist + role setup by Monday morning.
3) Marissa/Rishi: schedule weekly check-ins — propose Tuesdays @ 10am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: acme-poc-scope-v1.docx, network-allowlist.csv

From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@acme.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap: ACME pilot (scope, metrics, timeline)

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. Quick clarifications:

- Confirmed: PII cannot leave Acme. We will provide redacted samples and an allowlist.
- Metrics: can we also add suggestion CTR (do agents accept suggested replies) as a secondary metric? We care about adoption in prod.
- Cost target: $1k/week is a hard ask for the finance team for this POC (they prefer lower but will accept with tradeoffs). Can Redwood provide an estimate of expected token volume for the 200-ticket eval?

Action items on our side:
- Tom will open a ticket with our infra team to create a staging role and provide the S3 path by EOD Monday.
- Procurement: procurement@acme.ai will expect a one-page SOW and an MSA/PO template.

We reviewed the attached scope and had one small ask: can you briefly call out data retention policy for logs during the POC? We need to confirm retention <= 30 days and auditability.

Appreciate the clear plan — we’ll confirm access Monday.

—Sarah
Head of Product, Acme.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.ai>, Tom Li <tom.li@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap: ACME pilot (scope, metrics, timeline)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Great, quick follow-ups from the SE side to keep Monday’s kickoff smooth:

1) Token volume estimate: for a 200-ticket eval with average ticket length ~250 tokens and prompts + responses averaging 350 tokens per call, rough estimate is ~12–18k tokens per run; multiply by evaluation runs (we usually do 3 runs for stability) => ~40–55k tokens. At Redwood hosted rates that roughly maps to $200–$450 for the eval runs (we’ll refine after we confirm prompt lengths).

2) Retention: Redwood will keep inference logs for the POC for debugging and evals but can redact PII and enforce 30-day retention; we’ll include explicit language in the SOW. If you need shorter retention we can do 7 days as an option.

3) Setup checklist (I’ll push a runbook to the Drive):
   - Add IPs from network-allowlist.csv to your firewall allowlist.
   - Provide an IAM role ARN with read access to the sample S3 prefix or pre-signed URLs.
   - Send a small set (10) of representative tickets via secure upload for an initial smoke test.

I’ll upload the prompt templates and the runbook first thing Monday morning.

Cheers,
Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
